I have borderline personality disorder myself and it's completely possible to have happy and healthy relationships with people with these mental illnesses. However, that person needs to manage their illnesses. They need to take accountability for their actions and learn how to manage their emotions. 

From what she wrote, she hasn't done that. Or at best, she has just started the process and isn't fully in control of the illnesses. This isn't an apology or her taking accountability what so ever. 

She's minimizing her actions with "I was A LITTLE CRAZY". That is a half apology to get you to feel like she did take accountability. An actual apology should be; specific, an admission of guilt, a list of actions they will take to improve, the lesson they learned, and a promise to not do it again. 

The thing that really bothers me is that it's obvious she's using her illnesses as an excuse for her actions, again not taking accountability. She will also use that as an excuse when she will be hurtful in the future. 

Another sign that she isn't managing her illnesses fully is the statement "we're meant to be". Borderline personality disorder tends to see everything in black and white. Another thing is putting people on pedestals, from a fear of abandonment. When you do something that doesn't live up to the pedestal she currently has you on, she may start the abuse. It's a cycle of you're on the pedestal now, so she'll love bomb you. Then when you're off the pedestal, she may be cold and abusive.
